policy: These exploratory runs selected the candidate and metric before the declared 20-pair campaign; none contributes to the formal interval.

rejectedShaderKeyPrototype.outcome: Discarded. In current Janus inputs the 30-frame counter run has 60 shader-key calls and zero string memoization hits; retaining this prototype was not justified.

renderOnlyScreen: Two exploratory pairs were neutral. The profile identified matrix serialization without Three.js renderer ancestors, so the independently declared qualification measures main-thread script CPU over complete native frame production.
